title: Agenda visible to all
description: Once an agenda is revealed, every seat and spectator sees it until it resolves: a banner under the top bar (one line on phones, tap for the card; open on desktop) with the agenda number, name, type, Elect/For-Against target, the printed outcomes (More/Less), who voted with their vote totals, the running tally, who is still to vote and the riders. It is derived only from public game state (agenda_in_play, agenda_choices, agenda_casts, agenda_predictions, agenda_log) and the catalog; no decision is needed. Every player id is shown as the seat's name with its badge. Mocked server for the variants; the real wasm engine for the last shots.

notes.title: Reproduce
notes.text: cd web && npm run build:wasm && rm -rf node_modules/.vite && npm run screenshots -- FW. The before-* PNGs were taken with TI4_SHOT_PREFIX=before on 0a18dd87.

notes.title: Data
notes.text: No engine change: agenda_in_play (already on main), agenda_casts, agenda_predictions and agenda_log are public state the page receives.
